_comment: Per-chain seat-map extraction config. Every value below was verified against a LIVE seat page on 2026-07-29 (see each chain's `verified` note) rather than guessed. Two strategies exist: `dom` parses rendered HTML with the CSS selectors here (offline-testable via  python -m app.scrape.debug <chain> saved.html ), while `geometry` needs a live browser because seat identity comes from layout geometry and resolved SVG gradients, not from attributes. A chain may also be marked `blocked`, meaning automated verification is impossible and we say so instead of pretending.

cinemark.disabled_reason: Cinemark's robots.txt disallows /TicketSeatMap, so its seat map must not be fetched; seats have to be checked manually. The parser below is verified and ready if that policy ever changes -- set disabled to false to re-enable it.
cinemark.verified: 2026-07-29 against /TicketSeatMap/ at Century Oakridge (TheaterId=477). Clean, explicit contract: 12 .seatRow containers, 199 button[available] seats, available=True|False, seattype=seat|companion|wheelchair, labels in .seatDesignation (e.g. 'A20'). Wait for .seat-placeholder.loading to clear before reading.

amc.verified: 2026-07-29 against /showtimes/<id>/seats at AMC Metreon 16. No login required, but the whole site sits behind a Queue-it waiting room (clears in ~15s). canvas: 0, svg: 198, and ZERO <text> elements — seat labels are SVG <path> glyph outlines, so labels are unreadable and CSS selectors match nothing. Seats are small <svg> boxes; clustering 196 of them by y produced 15 clean rows, and availability comes from the resolved gradient stop-colors below (45 available / 137 occupied, confirmed against a screenshot).
amc.note_render_race: The seat SVGs paint AFTER load-state events settle, so extraction polls until at least min_seats_expected seats exist. Evaluating on 'networkidle' alone intermittently returned 0 seats, which is indistinguishable from 'markup changed'.

regal.verified: 2026-07-29. The seat page is behind a Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA, which we will not attempt to solve, so the exact seat map is unreachable. The theatre LISTING is reachable and robots-permitted, though, and it publishes sold-out state semantically: <button disabled aria-label="10:30pm showtime, sold out">. ?date=MM-DD-YYYY selects the day (verified: 107 showtimes, 7 sold out for 08-01-2026). Showtimes are attributed to a film via the nearest ancestor containing a /movies/<slug> link, since the CSS classes are generated hashes.
regal.blocked_reason: Regal gates seat selection behind a Cloudflare CAPTCHA, so exact seats must be checked manually.
regal.sold_out_reason: Regal lists this showtime as sold out, so it cannot seat your group.
regal.not_sold_out_reason: Regal still has tickets for this showtime, but its seat map is behind a CAPTCHA, so the exact seat layout must be checked manually.
